claims.claim: Consolidated net profit increased by 28.19 percent to INR 12,615 crore in Q2 FY26
claims.quote: The company at a consolidated level has earned a higher net profit, that is profit after tax of INR 12,615 crore during the Q2 FY26 as against INR 9,841 crore during Q2 FY25, an increase of INR 2,774 crore (28.19%).

claims.claim: Standalone crude oil production grew by 1.2 percent over corresponding period of FY25
claims.quote: The standalone crude oil production during Q2 FY26 and H1 FY26 were 4.630 million metric tons and 9.314 million metric tons, respectively, registering a growth of 1.2% over the corresponding period of FY25.

claims.claim: New well gas revenue reached INR 3,352 crore in H1 FY26
claims.quote: Gas from new wells continues to be the key contributor with revenue from new well gas reaching INR 3,352 crore in H1 FY26.

claims.claim: Interim dividend approved at 120 percent translating to INR 6 per equity share
claims.quote: the ONGC Board has approved an interim dividend of 120%, translating to INR 6 per equity share of INR 5 face value.

pushback.quote: If I look at the H1 run rate of -- am I audible, sir? I was saying that if I look at the H1 run rate of oil and gas production versus the annual guidance, do you think that there is any downside risk that we face?

Just wanted to understand how should we look at the business for the next two quarters. Are we seeing an improvement in realizations? Or, I mean, what has really driven the kind of improvement we've seen in terms of EBITDA?

pushback.topic: KG Basin production ramp-up and timeline

claims.quote: The reported standalone gross revenue of INR 46,460 crore, an increase of over 45% over the corresponding quarter of the last year.

claims.claim: Highest-ever standalone quarterly profit before tax of INR 22,848 crore

Management touted 112% PAT growth in Q1 FY27 standalone; consolidated Q1 FY27 PAT fell 43.3% YoY to ₹6,554 crore.

Five-year cash conversion remains robust with average OCF to PAT ratio at 2.06.

Borrowings remain elevated at ₹183,002 crore as of Sep 2026 with D/E at 0.46.
